# Whitney Stevenson

> San Francisco-based event and hospitality leader with 10+ years of B2B event marketing experience across technology and entertainment. Available for full-time roles in San Francisco or remote.

## Who She Is

Whitney Stevenson is a B2B event marketing operator and event concierge based in San Francisco. She specializes in white-glove execution for technology channel programs, experiential brand activations, and high-stakes entertainment events.

Signature accomplishments:
- Built Illumio's first-ever Latin America channel partnership program from scratch (Brazil, São Paulo, Mexico).
- Three consecutive years anchoring Arxan Technologies' presence at RSA Conference, including booth fabrication, ROI tracking, and pipeline attribution.
- On-the-ground production for PepsiCo Tostitos at Super Bowl 2026.
- Artist relations for the Latin America Billboard Awards (three performing artists, backstage hospitality, run-of-show, broadcast precision).
- Co-founder of the women's club at Presidio Golf Course (West Coast's second-oldest course); 300+ tournaments executed across seven years.
- Founder of an entrepreneurial sunglasses retail venture in two San Francisco locations.
- Practicing bodyworker — Facial Release and Access Consciousness.

## What She Looks For

- Full-time event marketing, field marketing, channel marketing, or hospitality leadership roles.
- San Francisco / Bay Area or remote.
- Mission-driven companies. Will start in event coordination if the team is right.

## Capabilities

- Channel partner program build (regional / international)
- B2B event production at scale (cybersecurity, SaaS, enterprise tech)
- Experiential marketing and brand activation
- Booth fabrication, ROI tracking, pipeline attribution
- High-pressure on-site execution / crisis management
- Artist relations, hospitality, riders, broadcast coordination
- Tournament and large-format event operations
